name: Uchinada (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Uchinada town emblem in green: two interlocking outlined rings.
history: Municipal flag of Uchinada, a town in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1962.

features.role: Uchinada town emblem — two interlocking outlined rings
